datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Mali in 2019. Geographic boundaries were classified into IPC phases (1-5) representing acute food insecurity severity levels, with multiple scenarios projected for near-term periods. Data was compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) with metadata on collection dates, scenarios, and classification scales.
